method.agreement: Require two adjacent AI responses in a single view. Native AI can support either filtered view. Preserve all baseline ranges.
method.baseline: The unchanged focused-window rule and its original measured directions.
method.point: Strictly above the largest admitted ordinary or background-only selection logit, separately for each band.
method.routing: Only inconclusive or unassessed three-second windows on the fixed dense grid. Admit filtered speech with the usual activity rule.

method.agreement: Two adjacent dense windows must lean AI, with at least one newly positive filtered view. Retain the focused result.
method.point: Strictly above the largest admitted genuine or isolated selection response.
method.routing: Existing dense native inconclusive and unassessed windows. Reapply speech activity to each filtered view.
method.view: Median magnitude across time versus frequency. Power-ratio harmonic gain with a 0.5 amplitude floor; original phase and length retained.
